# Project Governance 2.6.2

This patch makes checking delivered work against the original requirements explicit in existing
implementation and review guidance.

- Before claiming completion, compare every in-scope requirement with the delivered behavior and
  existing validation evidence. When both a PRD and spec govern the work, check both and identify
  omissions or contradictions. With one document, use that document; with neither, use the original
  request and approved clarifications.
- Distinguish missing behavior from unproven claims. Reuse valid evidence and add validation only
  for a named gap. Closeout cites the governing sources, supporting evidence, and remaining gaps or
  approved exceptions.
- Simple work can use a short conclusion instead of a mandatory requirement matrix.

No new acceptance stage, reviewer, ledger, runtime enforcement, or telemetry collector is added.
This is an instruction change; its effect on field accuracy remains to be evaluated on real work.
Existing compatible startup integration from 2.5.0 remains supported.
